caption: The drawing features a circular plate with a scalloped edge, depicted from a top-down view in the upper portion and as a cross-sectional side view in the lower portion. The top-down view shows the plate as having a wavy, scalloped border colored with a faint blue outline. Inside the plate, there is a wide circular band decorated with a repeated pattern of drop-shaped or petal-like motifs, rendered in shades of blue with white highlights. The center of the plate consists of two concentric rings, both outlined in blue. Below this, the lower part of the drawing presents a linear cross-section of the plate, emphasizing the undulating edge, the stepped interior, and the change in height from the edge towards the center. The cross-sectional view is drawn in simple black lines and labeled "EARLY AMERICAN PLATE" with the additional note "CROSS SECTION OF PLATE ACTUAL SIZE" beneath it. The background of the image is an off-white color.
title: Glass Plate
